messages:
tom (oncall): Alert: sustained p99 latency and some 502s on hosted embeddings in ap-south since ~22:40 UTC. Filing INC-2026-04-15-63. Need quick comms plan — statuspage + webinar note?
aly (Marcom): Thanks. Scope? Hosted-only? any dedicated/private impact?
tom (oncall): Hosted-only. Dedicated unaffected. Estimated 15-25% of requests affected.
jen (Support): A few customers pinged support already. Please include the 'dedicated/private unaffected' line in any public copy.
aly (Marcom): Draft statuspage short: "Investigating We are seeing increased latency and intermittent errors on Redwood hosted API in AP-South. Engineers are investigating; updates every 30 minutes." OK to publish?
omar (Events): We have a live APAC webinar in 25m. If demos hit hosted endpoints we should postpone. Can someone confirm demo dependencies?
tom (oncall): Demos use hosted endpoints. Recommend postponing to avoid failed demos.
aly (Marcom): Publishing statuspage now and prepping a registrant pause note. Holding enterprise email for 30m unless condition worsens.
jen (Support): I'll prep canned support snippet: "We're investigating intermittent errors in AP-South (hosted). Live updates: <statuspage>. Dedicated/private unaffected. Try routing to another region if possible."
i18n-bot: queued translations (EN->ZH/JA/FR) ETA 25m.
tom (oncall): 22:55 UTC update: mitigation attempted (routing rollback) showing early improvement. Monitoring for full recovery.
aly (Marcom): Holding webinar notice until confirm. Draft registrant copy: "Live demo paused due to a transient service issue affecting hosted endpoints in AP-South. We'll reschedule and send a new link shortly. Apologies for the inconvenience."
jen (Support): Approved. I'll update helpdesk macros and monitor replies.
aly (Marcom): Post-incident plan: send resolved + root-cause + routing/retry best-practices at T+60, include webinar reschedule. Keep this thread open for inbound escalations.
tom (oncall): Moving to monitoring at 23:05 UTC; errors near baseline. Will close INC after stable window.
aly (Marcom): Thanks team 44d
